scope: M7: simulator workbench runs as a native Windows x86-64 desktop app (build, launch, simulate, export, shutdown tested); IPC core and frozen worker also tested on Linux x86-64; Linux and macOS bundles not yet built

platform.native_host: Ubuntu via WSL, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, Rust 1.99.1, Python 3.14.4
platform.windows_native: Windows 11, Rust 1.99.1 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, MSVC 14.51, Windows SDK 10.0.26100, WebView2 156.0.4314.50

tests.python: tests/test_desktop_worker.py (21 tests, including a simulator job lifecycle through the worker)
tests.rust: desktop/core: 5 unit + 9 integration tests on Windows and Linux, clippy -D warnings, rustfmt
tests.frozen_sidecar: PyInstaller 6.22.3 one-file workers for Linux x86-64 (12.9 MB) and Windows x86-64 (11.2 MB); handshake with PYTHON* variables removed; supervisor integration test against each binary

requirements.DESKTOP-002: Frozen worker starts without system Python on Windows and Linux x86-64; strict version/protocol/operation handshake; only the sidecar next to the shell executable is launched; the whole worker tree is killed on shutdown, cancellation, timeout and protocol errors, and with the app on Windows via Job Object. macOS pending CI
requirements.DESKTOP-003: Unknown commands, malformed messages, shell-style arguments, oversized requests/responses and path escapes reject in shell core and worker, including from the live Windows webview; Tauri permission check refuses unlisted commands; cancellation, grandchild cleanup and crash restart tested
requirements.DESKTOP-006: Missing native PYTHIA8/DELPHES runtime disables only the collision mode; the analytic simulator, display and export work in the desktop app without Docker or WSL

pending.DESKTOP-001: Windows x86-64 built and launched locally (installer not executed); Linux and both macOS bundles need native runners

windows_build.webview_probe: runs.list, engine.capabilities and detector.geometry succeeded through heplab_invoke; unknown op, path escapes, CSP-blocked external fetch and unlisted plugin command refused
windows_build.lifecycle: No worker processes after normal close or force-kill of the app
windows_build.defect_fixed: Killing the one-file bootloader orphaned the Python child; workers now run in a kill-on-close Job Object (Windows) or their own process group (Unix)

simulator_app.frontend: src/heplab/server/static workbench, copied by desktop/prepare_frontend.py; CMS display layers bundled and SHA-256 checked
simulator_app.run: Analytic thin-slab bench submitted from the UI, completed (educational_unvalidated), particle table populated, result exported to JSON (179 KB)
simulator_app.shutdown: Clean exit with no worker processes after normal close and after force-kill
simulator_app.unavailable: PYTHIA8/DELPHES collision mode reported unavailable and disabled (no native runtime in the app)
defects_fixed: Run disabled without a session token
Exit could wait indefinitely on a held worker lock
